protocol.question: Can a fixed-budget query directed to actual same-layer queued seeds find useful residual no-new-cross walk alternatives, where legacy crossing-terminal Dijkstra does not settle those seeds?

evidence.qualification: Physical walk comparisons not congestion-aware dominance or legal-extension/final STA certificates. Four guided groups favor an additional preferred crossing, so blanket suppress-on-sink-layer-seed is not justified.

protocol.scope: Offline saved actual complete seed groups first, no native route or router changes in first stage.
arms: Q0 zero heuristic, one shared256 expansion budget per actual seed-group
Qh multi-target spatial ordering toward current source set with partial-tree Tdel as terminal cost, same shared256/label16384/heap65536 caps
Optional sequential-single-seed control with same total256 work, only if needed to distinguish multi-target allocation from heuristic ordering
protocol.method: Reverse same-layer BB-admitted RR walk from sink toward all actual queued sink-layer source IDs; virtual target edges at sources carry saved physical seedTdel. Virtual edges are analysis only, never RR resources. Use existing independently tested H3dCandidatePath generic query engine or exact parity port. Non-admissible geometry orders work only; frontier-g lower bound alone certifies optimum, discovered path is only UB until certified. Validate every real directed edge/weight and compare all exact claims to sealed offline full-Dijkstra oracle. Include storage/work-limit and source==sink cases. Record query work, unknown, actual best seed and physical witness. No enlarged legacy4096 or concealed fresh query work.
protocol.followup: Only after useful coverage/validity: native read-only integration using actual successful seed set, static reverse-distance/path reuse and current price snapshots, then separately registered reliability-weighted guide/planning no-new-cross alternative. Compare default-off and query-only controls before scoring; no blanket attenuation based solely on sink-layer seed existence.
protocol.formal_timing: Any candidate timing claim needs same-environment fresh measurement. Saved offline oracle work is research cost, not unchanged online planning cost.

cpp_query: Exact existing H3dCandidatePath header, stop-at-first-path1, label16384/heap65536/shared256 per arm per seedgroup.
heuristic: Qh min(seedTdel +4*graphunit*Manhattan_lowXY/max(1,mean_planar_span)); ordering only; Q0 zero.
virtual_target: Single virtual target after each actual seed, edge cost saved Tdel, not a physical RR edge.
